sentences.en: Owing to the rain, the athletic meeting was put off.
sentences.zh: 由于下雨，运动会推迟了。

sentences.en: The boy put on his athletic shoes and ran outside.
sentences.zh: 男孩穿上运动鞋跑到外面去了。

sentences.en: Jane had her hair cut short before the athletic meet.
sentences.zh: 简在运动会前把头发剪短了。

senses.zh: 运动员的,运动的,体格健壮的,行动敏捷的
